resources.string: Hi! I\'m Lunina, your intelligent DVB companion. How can I help you today?
Sorry, I\'m having trouble retrieving the data right now. Could you try again?
Hi! I\'m Lunina. I can help you find departures or plan connections in Dresden. What are you looking for?
Which stop would you like to know the departures for?
I found the stop %1$s, but there are currently no departures.
Checking the DVB network... There are no major disruptions at the moment, but line 3 has about a 5-minute delay at the main station.
You\'re very welcome! Have a good trip with the DVB.
That sounds interesting! As your DVB assistant, I can best help you if you ask about stops, departures, or lines.
